headline: TXT's 'I'll See You There Tomorrow' hits 100M on Spotify
sub: A 2024 B-side becomes the group's 22nd song past 100M streams
source: Source: BIGHIT MUSIC via Korean media (Tenasia, Sports Kyunghyang)
caption:
TXT's 'I'll See You There Tomorrow' has passed 100 million streams on Spotify.

The track, a B-side from the group's 2024 mini album 'minisode 3: TOMORROW', crossed the mark on Nov 25 after a fan-driven revival earlier this year. It's the 22nd TXT song to reach 100M on the platform. Meanwhile, the group keeps promoting new mini album 'PERFECT STORM' and its title track 'Angel Bite' on music shows this weekend.
